findings.summary: quote() keeps / unescaped by default, so a table name containing ../ writes its file outside the database directory.
read_only=True still creates a missing directory, because only create_dirs is checked before os.makedirs.
Every file not starting with a dot counts as a table, so other files in the directory are parsed as JSON and deleted by the next write.

_replace removes its temporary file only when the failure is an OSError, so a write that fails for another reason, such as a document the configured encoding cannot represent, leaves a stray temporary file in the database directory.
